author: gtasixinfo
text:
Everything you need to know about the GTA 6 Limited Edition DualSense controllers:

- The controllers are priced at $84.99 / €84.99 / £74.99 each.

- Pre-orders begin September 10th at 7:00am PT/10:00am ET in the U.S.

- Both the black and white versions launch on November 19 alongside GTA 6.

- The design features GTA 6 branding across the touchpad with purple and blue accents inspired by Vice City.
